# PinPixl

PinPixl is a set of free online photo tools for location, metadata and image formats. No sign-up. Most tools run in the visitor's browser; when the server is used, files are processed in memory and not stored.

## Location & metadata
- Geo Tagging Tool: add GPS coordinates and local SEO metadata (title, keywords, business name) to photos. Available in 13 languages. /free-geo-tagging-tool
- EXIF Viewer: see camera, lens, settings, date, GPS on a map and every EXIF/XMP/IPTC tag. /exif-viewer
- Photo Location Finder: find where a photo was taken from its GPS metadata. /photo-location-finder
- Remove EXIF Data: strip GPS location and metadata from photos, lossless for JPG/PNG/WebP. /remove-exif-data
- Lat Long Finder: get latitude and longitude for any address, or the address for coordinates. /lat-long-finder

## Convert images
- Image Converter (any to JPG, PNG or WebP): /image-converter
- HEIC to JPG: /heic-to-jpg
- HEIC to PNG: /heic-to-png
- WebP to JPG: /webp-to-jpg
- WebP to PNG: /webp-to-png
- JPG to WebP: /jpg-to-webp
- PNG to WebP: /png-to-webp
- PNG to JPG: /png-to-jpg
- JPG to PNG: /jpg-to-png
- AVIF to JPG: /avif-to-jpg
- AVIF to PNG: /avif-to-png
- SVG to PNG: /svg-to-png

## Optimize & SEO
- Image Compressor: reduce JPG, PNG and WebP file size. /image-compressor

## Important note
Geotagging can support image organisation and local SEO workflows, but it does not guarantee Google rankings. Google Business Profile removes EXIF data from published photos.
